title: Design: the Split Work Order dialog
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with two labor lines, one with 2 parts and one with 3 parts.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Split Work Order in the work order's three-dot menu.
  3. Tick the second line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • A dialog titled "Split Work Order" reads "Choose the lines to move. Each line's labor and parts move together to a new work order for" and customer B's name.
  • Each line shows a checkbox, its name and its part count ("2 parts", "3 parts"), with Cancel and a blue Split button, as in picture 11.3.

Step 3:

  • The second line's checkbox is ticked.
